architecture_contract.moment_arithmetic_slice: 16 signed sum plus 16 unsigned square/sumsq updates
architecture_contract.state_organization: channel-resident banked raw-moment state; arithmetic slices rotate across six 16-channel subtiles per 96-channel packet
architecture_contract.decoupling: ready-valid output tap and bounded packet FIFO; producer descriptor/compute cycles drain moment work before the dynamic-BN barrier
architecture_contract.fifo_bit_accounting: 96x32 payload only; lane-tile address, operator/epoch/tag, first/last, and channel-bank sideband are explicitly excluded pending RTL; Local, Hybrid, and conservative dual-line capacities are reported separately
architecture_contract.barrier: each operator drains all moment work before coefficient generation
architecture_contract.retained_materialization: producer output write plus fused BN-ATLIF replay read

claim_boundary: Exact ordered producer/moment scheduling DSE for the frozen H67 ep35 single sample and 13 direct M4-to-dynamic-BN-to-ATLIF regions. Region cycles retain M19's payload-only 64 GB/s and perfect compute/payload-overlap assumptions. The model is not full-network timing, measured DRAM, RTL proof of the banked scheduler, accuracy, energy, FPS, physical PPA, or speedup over an equally resourced implementation of the same elastic dataflow.
